description: Fires when the opponent threatens to win in column 1 right above their own stone: strongest (20-47) when they have three stones stacked on top of column 1 with the cell above empty; weaker (1-12) when their last move went into column 1 and the cell directly above it completes a horizontal or diagonal four. Vertical threes in other columns, my own three in column 1, and column-1 threats made by moves elsewhere do not fire.
effect: Pushes the move toward column 1 (the block): forcing it high moved column 1 from 0.03 to 1.00 in one position and +0.14 in another; zeroing it changes little when the block is already obvious.
notes: Dev F1: col-1 vertical only 0.427 (P 0.99), +any col-1 must-block 0.515 (P 0.59), +threat directly above opponent's last col-1 stone 0.513 (P 0.71, chosen), diagonal-only 0.482, late-game cutoff 0.488. The top 1% is almost entirely the col-1 vertical three; the 97-98th pct band is diffuse (last-move column ~uniform) and unexplained. Simulation ceiling negative, share nan. Synthesis 49.3 beats dev max 47.5.
